lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 上世纪六十年代，孕妇服用的镇静药沙利度胺，让数以千计的婴儿四肢残缺。后来发现，这种分子有“左手”和“右手”两个版本，在体内作用不同。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 分子怎么会有左右手？伸出双手：它们互为镜像，却怎么转都叠不到一起。很多分子也这样，这叫“手性”。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 最早看见它的，是一八四八年的巴斯德。他发现酒石酸盐的晶体分成镜像的两种，就用镊子一颗颗挑开。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 更怪的是，生命只用一只手。蛋白质里的氨基酸，几乎全是左手型。身体里的“锁”也分左右，药分子得是对的那把“钥匙”。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 可在烧瓶里，左右手总是一半对一半。怎么只造一种？办法是手性催化剂，它像一副左手手套模具，专门压出左手分子。这条路拿了二〇〇一年诺奖。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 但大家默认：模具多纯，产品就多纯。更大的谜是：最早的生命没有纯模具，单一手性从哪儿来？
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 一九五三年，物理学家弗兰克写下一份“配方”：产物要能复制自己，还要压住自己的镜像。几十年来，没人做得出。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 一九八六年，法国化学家卡根打破了默认。他想到，催化剂常常是两个手性分子抱着一个金属原子干活。左配左、右配右，干得快；一左一右的混搭，几乎干不动。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 于是少数派被多数派拉去混搭，等于被冻住了。结果，产品竟比催化剂还纯。这叫“非线性效应”。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed. Clear articulation of every syllable; natural short pauses at commas, slightly longer at full stops; lift slightly on questions.

lines.text: 日本化学家硖合宪三把它推到了极致。一九九五年，他找到一种会“自己造自己”的分子：左手分子造出更多左手分子，像复印机印出新的复印机，还越印越纯。
lines.style: Warm, lively Mandarin popular-science host explaining to beginners. Natural conversational pace - engaged and moving forward, not slow, never rushed.
